correction: Earlier documents claimed FTW was 'within 8% of the registry'. That compared FTW's whole-taluk area (13,062 ha, including 736 ha inside Reserve Forest and all non-village land) against a registry covering only the 21 revenue villages. Like for like, FTW finds materially LESS than the registry.
reading: FTW recovers ~59% of registry cropped area inside the villages, and ~75% of the annual-crop area. It under-delineates even annual arable, so the 'strong on annual, weak on tree crops' story is only part of the shortfall. Other candidates, none isolable with this data: Rabi-only imagery windows missing fallow or late-sown fields, cloud-affected scenes, the Sentinel-2 5.11 processing-baseline mismatch, and small fields below the 500 m2 floor.
